goal:
You are training a machine learning interatomic potential (a MACE model) for
the ethanol molecule, using DFT data from the rMD17 dataset.

The goal: a model with a force error below 20.0 meV/Å on the
held-out test frames, that also runs stably in MD: over 1 ps starting at
500 K, the total energy should stay within
0.01 eV, no two atoms should come closer than
0.75 Å, and the bonds should stay the same.

You start with 200 training frames and can add more, up to
1000. You may train at most 5 times. Training takes
minutes, so do not waste trainings. Use the tools one at a time, read each result,
and decide the next step. Every model must be evaluated and checked in MD before you
can say it meets the goal. Call stop when the goal is met, or when it cannot be met
within the limits, and give the reason.
